problem_1.description: No public constructors — cannot call 'new Processor()'
problem_1.compiler_error: CS1729: 'Processor' does not contain a constructor that takes 0 arguments

problem_2.description: All methods are instance methods — cannot call them statically
problem_2.compiler_error: CS0120: An object reference is required for the non-static field, method, or property 'Processor.From(string)'
problem_2.evidence: is_static: false for From(), To(), Execute() in api-catalog.json

paradox_analysis.combined_effect: Cannot instantiate (CS1729) AND cannot call statically (CS0120). No code path can reach any Processor method.
paradox_analysis.api_pattern: FLUENT_BUILDER — From(inputFile).To(outputFile, SaveFormat.Pdf).Execute() is a fluent chain but requires a Processor instance to start
paradox_analysis.entry_point_missing: The fluent chain requires an initial Processor instance, but there is no public static factory method and no public constructor

processorcontext_investigation.assessment: ProcessorContext has a public constructor (1) but zero methods. It appears to be a settings/context container, not a factory for Processor. Cannot produce a Processor instance from ProcessorContext.
processorcontext_investigation.catalog_note: Neither the Processor nor any other type in Aspose.Words.LowCode exposes a public static factory returning Processor.

attempted_code_patterns.note: constructors: [] means no public constructors exist at all
is_static: false confirmed in catalog; static call syntax is invalid

attempted_code_patterns.pattern: var ctx = new ProcessorContext(); var processor = ctx.GetProcessor();
attempted_code_patterns.result: NOT_POSSIBLE — ProcessorContext has 0 methods, no factory method exists
attempted_code_patterns.note: ProcessorContext is a settings container, not a Processor factory

resolution.immediate: Processor removed from words.yml allowed_types. Added to backlog with PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED state.

backlog_entry.detail: constructors:[] + all instance methods (From/To/Execute all is_static:false) = CS1729+CS0120. No code path can reach any Processor method.
backlog_entry.required_external_change: Aspose.Words package version upgrade that either (a) adds a public constructor to Processor, or (b) makes From() static, or (c) adds a public static factory method returning Processor

future_investigation.check_changelog: Review Aspose.Words 26.6.0+ changelog for Processor API changes
future_investigation.check_reflection_depth: Verify DllReflector did not miss internal factory methods due to max_depth or access modifier filtering
future_investigation.check_interface: Investigate if Processor implements an interface with a factory pattern (e.g., IProcessorFactory in a companion class)
future_investigation.check_aspose_docs: Check official Aspose.Words LowCode documentation for Processor usage examples — may reveal undiscovered entry point

lesson_learned.catalog_check_rule: Before adding ANY type to allowed_types: verify constructors.length > 0 OR at least one method has is_static:true. Types with constructors:[] and all instance methods are unreachable without a factory.
lesson_learned.automation_needed: VR-012 in validator-pattern-registry.json: automate this check in type_classifier.py before planning
